verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Appwrite acting as an MCP server that external clients such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Appwrite itself consuming third-party MCP servers or using their tools. A platform like this could plausibly ship an in-product assistant that acts as an MCP client, so the axis applies, but the server-role evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
